source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently authored, photorealistic, testable full-body image of an unmistakably adult woman at a randomized complex night-trail checkpoint, using the supplied portrait only for facial, hair, and general-appearance guidance, while leaving the athletic wardrobe topology explicitly unspecified until post-core interpretation.
subject: one unmistakably adult woman in performance activewear whose exact garment topology remains explicitly unspecified
setting: a bioluminescent forest night trail checkpoint with wet roots, phosphorescent moss, suspended route markers, and floating pollen
event: the woman crosses a luminous trail checkpoint in a separated running stride as floating pollen reveals the depth of the forest
visual_priorities: The waist, hips, both thighs, both leg openings, and every garment hem must remain fully visible and inspectable.
Show the complete adult figure from the top of the head through both shoes, with a clear face, separated legs, and readable trail-checkpoint action.
Keep the checkpoint markers and floating pollen distributed around the silhouette so the athletic figure remains visually legible.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body night-trail photograph of one unmistakably adult woman crossing a luminous trail checkpoint in a separated running stride. She wears performance activewear whose exact garment topology remains explicitly unspecified. The supplied portrait guides only the adult subject's facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and general appearance. Wet roots lead through phosphorescent moss, translucent route markers, and layered tree trunks while floating pollen catches teal and amber light around her silhouette. A low camera-height viewpoint shows the complete adult figure from the top of the head through both shoes, her face readable and her motion naturally balanced. The waist, hips, both thighs, both leg openings, and every garment hem must remain fully visible and inspectable. Place checkpoint markers and luminous pollen around rather than across the figure, preserving crisp textile edges, natural skin texture, realistic fabric tension, and dimensional forest depth.
